description: The mutation campaign for P-022 step 7a checkpoint 2 (the engine protocol: how each engine reports its per-layer outputs, and what it declares it could produce). Separate from the cp1 campaign on purpose — each checkpoint's evidence stays frozen at what it measured, so a later checkpoint cannot quietly restate an earlier one's numbers. Every mutation edits a PRODUCTION surface — ownlang/repro.py or rust/crates/own-shadow/src/ — never a test. Three layers run for every mutation (discipline 3: no fail-fast), including the port's own engine suite. M00 is the harness-honesty control.

control.description: harness-honesty control: no mutation at all, which must report zero failing layers

mutations.description: the reference stops declaring a projection on its layers
mutations.rule: engine protocol: every layer declares what its engine could produce

mutations.description: the reference silently drops the foreign engine entries when regenerating
mutations.rule: engine protocol: an engine writes only its own entry, and carries foreign ones through
mutations.pattern: \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ if\ isinstance\(entry,\ dict\)\ and\ entry\.get\("id"\)\ !=\ ENGINE_PYTHON:
mutations.replacement: if False and isinstance(entry, dict) and entry.get("id") != ENGINE_PYTHON:

mutations.description: the reference's verification accepts a partial projection that names no members
mutations.rule: engine protocol: a partial projection must NAME the members it carries

mutations.description: the reference's verification accepts a 'full' projection that also names members
mutations.rule: engine protocol: a full projection emits the whole surface and claims nothing else
mutations.pattern:
\ \ \ \ if\ kind\ ==\ PROJECTION_FULL:\
\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ for\ name\ in\ \("members",\ "reason"\):

mutations.description: the port declares its verdict layer FULL while emitting a short record (the over-claim that became reachable when the layer stopped being partial, #259 cp5.1/5.2)
mutations.rule: engine protocol: a projection that over-claims is exactly what the field exists to prevent

mutations.description: the port drops `column` from its verdict records while still claiming it
mutations.rule: engine protocol: a projection names exactly the members its documents carry

mutations.description: the port stamps a refused layer with the 'produced' status
mutations.rule: artifact: status is produced or refused, and a refusal carries no document

mutations.description: the port claims a surface version for the MOS dump, which has none
mutations.rule: artifact: surface_version is null when the surface has none — absence is data

mutations.description: the port reports a typed-door refusal on one layer instead of all three
mutations.rule: artifact: every engine reports exactly the frozen layers, in that order

mutations.description: the port's verification stops rejecting a 'full' projection that names members
mutations.rule: engine protocol: a full projection emits the whole surface and claims nothing else

mutations.description: the port's verification accepts an EMPTY reason on a partial projection
mutations.rule: engine protocol: a partial projection must say WHY the remaining members are absent
